race.description: Pryde's Easifeed Stamina Up To Nr45 Conditioned Trotters Hcp
race.comment: CROOKWELL EYES (7) ran fourth last start at this track over 2138m, beaten 21 metres. Perfectly placed and is sure to be there at the finish. TRINITY RAINBOW (1) has been a bit hot and cold and that continued last start when she finished third, beaten 4 metres, in a nice return to form at this track over 2138m. Tackles a similar assignment and she can find her way to the winners' stall. BUCKLES (5) is worth plenty of thought off a last-start win by 1.5 metres at this track over 2138m. LAYDOWNLUNA (4) is in the mix after turning in a better effort last start to finish second at this track over 2138m.
